resources.string: Speak on the go - Tapedo turns it into index cards.
The stack is empty. Press the red button and say what you need to do.
Without the microphone Tapedo cannot hear your note. Allow the microphone in the phone settings.
This phone has no speech recognition. Install or enable the Google app.
I did not hear anything. Press the button and say it again.
Speech recognition could not reach the internet. Check the connection, or download the language for offline use in the phone\'s speech recognition settings - then no internet is needed.
Speech recognition is busy with another app. Try again in a moment.
Something went wrong with the microphone. Try again.

The phone has no offline pack for this language, so nothing was sent. Online recognition sends your voice to Google. You can also download the offline pack in the phone\'s speech recognition settings.
The phone has no offline pack for this language, and online recognition is turned off in Settings. Download the offline pack in the phone\'s speech recognition settings.
Tapedo picks the type from your words: “buy” makes a shopping list, “at 10” an event, “idea” an idea.
A plain note - the text as you say it.
Each thing on its own line, to tick off. E.g. “packing list: towels, sunscreen, charger”.
One thing to do, with a due date if you say one (“on Friday”).
A loose thought for later - no due date, no priority.
Date, time and place, e.g. “Tuesday at 10 at the dentist”.
A shopping list, grouped by shop section on its own: dairy, bakery, produce…
“On silence” ends when you stop talking. “Stop button” keeps listening until you stop it.
A safety net for when you forget to stop.
The phone recognises speech in this language. Mixed notes (e.g. Polish words in an English sentence) usually work too.

When the phone has no offline pack for the speech language, online recognition sends your voice to Google. On phones with on-device recognition (usually Android 12 and newer) your voice never leaves the phone without your consent. On others the system may go online by itself.
The change could not be saved. Try again.
Every new card gets this priority (the coloured tape in its corner). Except: say “urgent” or “important” and it gets high, say “someday” or “no rush” and it gets low. Ideas have no priority.
Makes the text in Tapedo bigger or smaller - on top of the text size set on the phone.
Cards and switches change instantly, without movement. Also on automatically when animations are off system-wide.

Notes are encrypted and stored only on this phone. Tapedo never saves sound - only the text is kept. Nothing leaves the phone unless you allow it: the note text goes to the AI provider you choose, and your voice goes to Google with online recognition.
Tapedo is built from open source libraries and fonts. Their licences follow in their original wording.
Simple rules structure your notes: a shopping list after “buy”, an event after “at 10”, priority after “urgent”, a due date after “tomorrow”. Works offline, and the note text never leaves the phone.
Google’s AI model. It splits a note into separate tasks and lists and fixes misheard words. The free plan has a daily request limit - you can see the current one in Google AI Studio.

Only the note text goes to Google - no recording, no data about you. In the EU, Switzerland and the UK, Google does not use it to improve its models, even on the free plan. Outside these countries the free plan lets Google use the text and have people read it - then do not dictate sensitive data.
Open Google AI Studio with the button below and sign in with a Google account.
Copy the key - it starts with “AIza” - and paste it below.
A service that runs open AI models very fast. It splits a note into separate tasks and lists. The free plan needs no payment card; it has per-minute and per-day request limits.

Only the note text goes to Groq (USA) - no recording, no data about you. Under its agreement Groq may not use it to train models. By default it does not keep requests; when troubleshooting it may keep logs for up to 30 days - you can turn that off in the Groq console (Data Controls, Zero Data Retention).
Open the Groq console with the button below and create an account (e-mail or Google account).
Copy the key - it starts with “gsk_” - and paste it below.
The key is encrypted on this phone and sent nowhere except the chosen provider.
No key yet - the no-AI rules work until you paste one.
“Save key” works once a key is pasted, “Check” once it is saved.
tomorrow buy bread and milk and on friday call the plumber it is urgent
Works. First card from the sample note: “%s”.
Paste and save a key first.
The provider rejected the key. Check that you copied all of it.
Free limit reached - try later. Until then the no-AI rules work.
Cannot reach the provider. Check your internet connection.
The provider has a temporary problem (error %d). Try later.
The provider answered in an unexpected way. Try again.
Simple rules wrote these cards instead of the AI. Reason: %s
Couldn\'t save the cards. Nothing is lost - try again.
Notes can\'t be opened right now. Nothing was deleted - try again.
Couldn\'t save the change. Try again.

Android lost the key they were encrypted with (it can happen after a system update or a screen lock change), so Tapedo started with an empty stack. The encrypted files were not deleted - they stay in the app\'s data, but nobody can read them without the key.
Say what to add to the list, e.g. “butter and eggs”.
What you say is added at the end of the text.
